title: net_watch::latest() re-probes the routing table on the UI thread on every poll while the route reads offline
trigger: Disconnect the network (or have no route to Telegram) and leave Quill open; the screen poll and each background account poll call poll_ticks(.., net_watch::latest()) every pump
effect: Each pump runs route_now(): two UDP bind/connect calls plus a netlink socket (Linux), SCDynamicStore lookups (macOS) or GetBestRoute2 (Windows), all under the tracker mutex that the watcher thread also needs; wasted work and possible UI stalls while offline, multiplied by the number of background accounts
fix: Let the watcher thread own the probe and publish a NetworkState (epoch, available) in an atomic; latest() only reads it, with a rate-limited re-probe owned by the watcher while offline.

title: Neighbour resolution is tracked in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: A gateway whose link-layer address is not yet resolved: Tracker::resolving (gateways asked), link::Resolving v4/v6 AtomicBools (resolve thread in flight) and Path::carried/settled (hardware carried over from the previous route)
effect: No bug today; a failed link::resolve (UDP bind failure) is never retried because Tracker::resolving already names the gateway, and a resolve thread that never returns holds its IP version flag forever
fix: One per-gateway enum Neighbour { Unasked, Asking{since}, Resolved(mac), GaveUp } owned by Tracker, replacing the flags.

title: Coalesce is a dirty + running pair of atomics that must change together
trigger: Windows network change delivers dozens of callbacks on system threads
effect: Correct today (the loop re-checks dirty after clearing running); the stage is encoded by two bools instead of Idle/Running/RunningDirty
fix: A single AtomicU8 with states Idle, Running, RunningDirty and compare_exchange transitions.

title: StageFacts mirrors request liveness as bools next to the NewChatStage enum
trigger: New Group/Channel flow: create_pending, type_pending, type_failed and outcome are derived from Session.requests and info_edit_errors on each draw and combined with NewChatStage by view()
effect: Stage and facts can disagree (Creating with no outcome and no live request shows the back step unbusy; Type{saving:Some} with a request that vanished goes straight to Subscribers as if the save succeeded)
fix: Put the request state in the stage: Creating{request, state: Fetch<ChatId>} and Type{saving: Saving{requests, state: InFlight|Failed(reason)|Done}} updated by the answer, instead of re-deriving it from the session.

title: NewChatStage::Type.saving: Option<Vec<RequestId>> is a 'save attempted' flag cleared by hand
trigger: Type step: Save sends requests (saving=Some), a refusal is read from groups.info_edit_errors[chat] (keyed by chat, field Username, not by request); typing in the link field sets saving=None via new_chat_link_edited
effect: A refusal from a save that is not the one in flight is shown for the current one, and a save whose requests all vanished without an answer moves on to Subscribers as if it succeeded
fix: Type{chat, save: TypeSave} with TypeSave::{Editing, Saving(requests), Refused(reason)}; match the refusal by request id.

title: A create guarded by purpose, not by dialog: closing the dialog mid-create leaves a silent no-op Create and an unexpected chat open
trigger: New group: fill name and members, press Create, close the dialog before TDLib answers, reopen New Group and press Create again
effect: create_new_chat returns Ok(None) while the first request is out and the UI ignores it (button does nothing); when the first answer arrives run_new_chat_created calls select_chat for the group although its dialog is gone; NewChatState.creations entries are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight create to the dialog (a Creating stage the closing dialog cancels or hands to a toast) and drop the creations entry when its answer is applied.

title: Widget crash streak lives in a counter beside Lifecycle
trigger: A widget stops repeatedly (CPU/memory/validator limit)
effect: Whether a Stopped widget restarts depends on WidgetEntry::crashes (reset in widgets_ui.rs at content change and first frame, bumped on stop) and on runtime.is_none() in widget_bubble.rs, not on the Lifecycle value alone
fix: Lifecycle::Stopped{reason, streak: u8} and Lifecycle::GaveUp{reason}, so the streak resets when the variant changes.

title: Signal handler stage is IN_HANDLER + REPORT_DONE + INSTALLED atomics
trigger: A fault in one thread while another faults
effect: Works today (first thread writes, others wait up to 2 s); stage is three separate bools
fix: One AtomicU8 with Idle, Reporting, Reported.

title: Active crash report file is shared by every running instance of Quill
trigger: Start a second Quill process on the same logs folder (a second profile run or a second launch) while the first runs, then quit the second cleanly
effect: install() truncates native-crash-active.txt and the second instance's clean quit (discard_active) removes it, so a later crash of the first instance leaves a closed-fd report nobody finds; the first instance's start-up promote_previous can also file the second's report
fix: Name the active file by pid (native-crash-active-<pid>.txt) and promote only files whose pid is dead.

title: Background unread is a process-global atomic written by the UI at several call sites
trigger: Account switch, retire_live_to_background, take_background_live, poll, stop_background_clients each call publish_background_unread
effect: A path that changes background clients without calling publish_background_unread leaves the tray, dock badge and window title with the old other-accounts count (also read without an owner key by window_chrome.rs)
fix: Derive the badge from BackgroundAccounts::total_unread when drawing, or make the clients list the single writer through a setter that publishes.

title: Notification bursts coalesce by chat only, so forum topics merge
trigger: A forum supergroup gets a message in topic A then one in topic B before the queue drains
effect: One toast reading 'N new messages'; the inline reply target message_id is the newest message, in topic B, and the first topic's title/body is lost
fix: Key the queue by (chat, topic) using the ChatMessage/topic owner key.

title: A theme save that fails after the QR box closed is dropped without a word
trigger: Pick a new backdrop in your QR box, close the box (Closing sends setProfileShareTheme), then the request fails (offline, rights lost)
effect: The box is gone and the poll step clears save_answers when no box is open (ui/peer_qr/mod.rs drain_peer_qr), so no toast; the person believes the theme was saved but the server still has the old one
fix: Report a save failure through the app's note (set_note) when no box is open to take the answer, or keep the failed pick in the session until the next box shows it.

title: PeerQrBox save stage is chosen + saving + failed + save_serial + served kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick, close panel, save, fail, pick again, rights change
effect: chosen/saving/failed/served move together in apply(); a missed arm leaves a pick unsaved or resent
fix: One enum Theme { Following(served), Picked(choice), Saving{serial,choice}, SaveFailed(choice) } with the transitions in one place.

title: Old save answer overwrites served and clears failed of a newer pick
trigger: Save A (serial 1), pick B and close panel (serial 2 fails), answer for serial 1 arrives late
effect: save_answer applies Ok(saved) to served and failed = None even when the ticket serial is not the one in flight, so the failed pick can be sent again
fix: Apply Ok/Err to served/failed only when the ticket serial equals the saving serial; otherwise only update served from the session.

title: FreeState requesting + serial + menu_open are a request stage plus a menu stage
trigger: Click the pill, open the menu while a request is on its way, account price changes
effect: requesting, serial and menu_open are reset by hand in request, drop_pending, sync and pill_clicked
fix: enum FreeUi { Idle, MenuOpen, Requesting{request,serial} } so a request closes the menu by construction.

title: contact_link Fetch is paired with a separate contact_error Option
trigger: getUserLink for the contact link fails
effect: UserLinkFetch::Failed and contact_error are set together and cleared separately (retry_contact_link, drain_peer_qr take()); Failed with no error or error with no Failed can occur
fix: UserLinkFetch::Failed(Option<String>) with the box taking the reason once (Fetch<T> shape).

title: ThemeGifts stage is loaded + complete + loading + retry_at + requested_at
trigger: Open the gifts panel, scroll to the end, a next page fails, close and reopen
effect: five fields encode idle/first-loading/ready/more-loading/failed-retry; wants_more and fail() must keep them consistent by hand
fix: enum GiftsFetch { Idle, FirstLoading, Ready{more:bool}, LoadingMore, RetryAfter(i64) } carrying the serial.

title: Backdrops stage is loading bool + requested_at Option
trigger: Open the QR box with no network, then with network
effect: loading and requested_at must be set by start() and cleared by fail(); a dropped answer with neither accept nor fail leaves loading true and due() false for the session
fix: Fetch<Vec<ShareThemeBackdrop>> with a timestamp in the Ready/Failed variant.

title: PinReorder stage is dragging Option + dropped Option + slides, and the owner keeps pin_reorder_archived beside it
trigger: Drag a pinned chat, release, drag another before the slide ends
effect: dragging/dropped/slides must agree; ChatListUi::pin_reorder and pin_reorder_archived must be set together (set in pin_drag_move only)
fix: enum Reorder { Dragging{..}, Dropping{..} } and put archived inside PinReorder.

title: Release sends the pinned list as it was when the drag began, not as it is now
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat; while holding, another device unpins chat X (or pins Y); release
effect: finish_pin_drag sends setPinnedChats with the begin-time snapshot: X is pinned again, Y is unpinned
fix: On release merge the dragged order into session.pinned_chat_ids (drop ids no longer pinned, keep new ones in place), or cancel the drag when the pinned set changes.

title: A drag whose release never reaches the list keeps dragging set and asks a frame every 60 ms
trigger: Begin a pinned drag, then Alt-Tab or lose the pointer capture so neither mouse_up nor mouse_up_out fires
effect: settled() stays false and sidebar upkeep (chat_list/sidebar.rs:325) keeps calling request_animation_tick(60) while dragging is Some, even when the window is inactive; the row stays lifted
fix: Cancel the reorder (release without saving) on window deactivation or when no button is down in the next move event.

title: Shuffle Previous/Next can return a message id that is no longer in the playlist
trigger: Shuffle music, skip a few tracks, delete one of the played messages, press Previous
effect: shuffled() returns played[cursor] without checking it is still in ids; the player is asked to start a missing message
fix: Filter played against ids before using the cursor (or drop vanished ids and re-seat the cursor).

title: ShuffleState played + cursor are two fields that move together and key tracks by a bare message id
trigger: Shuffle in chat A then play in chat B
effect: played ids carry no chat; note_current resets only when the current id is not at the cursor
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) via OwnedBy and make the round one value with the cursor inside it.

title: PlaybackClock playing state is started_at Option beside base_secs
trigger: Let a track reach its end without the UI calling pause
effect: finished_at() stays true on every call while started_at is Some; the caller must pause to leave the state
fix: enum Clock { Paused{at}, Playing{from,since}, Ended } so the end is a stage with its own exit.

title: Keychain delete reports success on every error
trigger: Log out or delete an account on macOS when the keychain item is locked or the delete is refused
effect: KeychainSecretStore::delete maps Err(_) to Ok(()); the wipe path believes the database key is gone while it stays in the keychain
fix: Return Missing as Ok and map every other status to SecretStoreError::Locked/Platform, as get does.

title: A failed key put leaves the raw key in the .key.tmp file
trigger: Disk full or rename fails while storing a new database key on Linux
effect: write_key_file_0600 writes the unsealed key to db-encryption.key.tmp; when rename_retrying fails the tmp file is never removed
fix: Remove tmp on every error path after it was created (guard with a drop-removing file).

title: answer_on_exit leaves an unreaped child when no waiter thread can start
trigger: Thread spawn fails (resource limit) while opening a link
effect: The Err arm answers true and drops child without wait(); a zombie stays until Quill exits
fix: Hand the child to child_reap::wait_in_background as the Windows path does.

title: PollDraft keeps parallel vectors and two exclusive deadlines
trigger: Remove a middle option of a quiz draft, switch from a preset period to a custom date
effect: options, option_media and quiz_correct index the same rows and must be edited together; open_period and close_date are exclusive but both stored (PollClose already models it)
fix: Vec<DraftOption{text,media,correct}> and Option<PollClose> instead of parallel fields.

title: Result bars of 0% show for a poll that is yet unsent or scheduled
trigger: View a scheduled or unsent poll in a chat
effect: poll_shows_results is true for any vote_restriction_reason, including YetUnsent and Scheduled, so zero-percent bars replace the option choices
fix: Show results only for reasons where the user can never vote and results exist (Closed, Country, Membership), not for YetUnsent/Scheduled.

title: Chat-row animation map is keyed by bare chat id in app-wide FrameUi, never reset on account switch and never pruned
trigger: Open the chat list of account A, switch to account B that has a chat with the same id (same private user), or scroll a row away while its online state changes and back
effect: The online dot or badge animates from the other account's or the stale last-seen state instead of snapping on first sight; the map grows with every chat id ever drawn
fix: Move RowFxMap into OnScreen (replaced whole on a switch) keyed by ChatId, and drop entries for rows not drawn this frame.

title: Toggle keeps target, from and since in step by hand; since=None doubles as the 'settled' flag
trigger: Any online/badge change
effect: No bug today: settled() treats since older than DURATION as settled while since stays Some
fix: enum Toggle { Settled(bool), Easing { target, from, since } } that collapses to Settled when the ease ends.

title: Rich HTML export stage is an Option<RichHtmlOutcome> behind Arc<Mutex> that callers poll; running is None
trigger: Save as HTML on a rich message
effect: No bug today: OutcomeSlot::drop guarantees Failed on panic and start_rich_html_export treats None as running
fix: enum ExportStage { Running, Done(RichHtmlOutcome) } held by the export and taken once by the driver.

title: JoinedLines.started bool says whether a first line was pushed, next to text
trigger: join_blocks / quoted
effect: No bug today; started is false only before the first push so it could be derived from a line count
fix: Count lines (Option<usize> of pushed lines) or push into a Vec<String> and join at the end.

title: MarkupBlocks text and chunks, and PreviewBlocks source and shown, are parallel values that must agree index for index and byte for byte
trigger: Every keystroke in the rich editor
effect: No bug today (fuzz tests compare with a fresh parse); a caller that mutates one half or swaps the struct between editors would show stale blocks
fix: Keep the pair in one private struct per editor whose only mutator is parse/update, as now, and never share one instance between composers (owner: ChatUi).

title: Linux screen-reader watcher runs once and never retries or restarts
trigger: Start Quill before the AT-SPI/session bus is up or let the bus restart, then turn the screen reader on
effect: running() stays false (or stale) for the rest of the process, so screen-reader-only behaviour is not enabled
fix: Make the watcher a supervised task that reconnects (state enum Connecting/Watching/Failed) instead of a Once.

title: Stale Stars-history and received-gifts errors are not matched to the live request
trigger: Open Stars, tap Incoming then Outgoing (or open gifts of channel A, close, open gifts of user B). The first request fails or is swept after its TTL (408) after the second was sent.
effect: The older failure sets tx_loading=false and tx_error (or gifts_loading=false, gifts_error) while the newer request is in flight, or over an already loaded list. The dialog shows an error, the spinner stops, and maybe_fetch_star_transactions can send a duplicate. Answers are matched by tx_request/gifts_request, errors are not (Grams does match them).
fix: Apply GetStarTransactions/GetReceivedGifts errors only when pending.id equals tx_request/gifts_request, as apply_grams_error does; better, hold the history as Fetch<Page> keyed by request id.

title: Stars history stage is tx_loaded + tx_loading + tx_error + tx_request kept in step by hand
trigger: Any Stars dialog open, tab switch, paging, or a gift mutation that sets tx_loaded=false from three other files.
effect: Both loading and error can be set; the reset in set_star_transactions_filter and the writers in gift_manage.rs/session_apply_ok.rs each clear a different subset.
fix: Fetch<StarTxList> with the request id in the Loading variant; filter and offset live in the Ready/Loading data.

title: Received gifts stage is gifts_loaded + gifts_loading + gifts_error + gifts_stale + gift_mutating + gifts_request
trigger: Open gifts, toggle visibility or convert a gift, page, close and reopen for another owner.
effect: Six fields that must change together; open_received_gifts resets some by hand and leaves gifts_loading to the next fetch.
fix: Fetch<GiftsList> keyed by owner and request id, plus a separate Mutation enum {Idle, Sending(RequestId)}; stale becomes a Refreshing variant.

title: Premium dialog data uses premium + premium_loading + premium_error, stickers loading + asked, business_features + loading
trigger: Open Premium, a sticker preview, or Business; any request fails.
effect: premium_stickers_asked is an 'asked once' bool cleared by hand on the error arm and send failure; business_features_loading has no error field so a failure silently falls back; premium_error plus premium_loading can both be set.
fix: Fetch<PremiumInfo>, Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>>, Fetch<Vec<BusinessFeature>> from src/state/fetch.rs.

title: A send failure on the first page of gifts or Stars after a tab switch leaves an empty list with no spinner and no error
trigger: Be briefly disconnected (chats_path_active false is checked first, but send_json_request can fail), open someone's gifts or switch the Stars tab; the UI ignores the Err for the tab switch (set_star_transactions_filter).
effect: open_received_gifts has already set gifts_open and cleared the list; fetch_received_gifts_page resets gifts_loading=false and sets no gifts_error. The box shows neither loading nor error nor rows. set_star_transactions_filter likewise clears transactions and tx_error stays None. set_grams_filter in connect/grams.rs does the same (error only set in open_grams).
fix: Fetch<T> with a Failed variant written on the send-failure arm, so every first-page start ends in Loading or Failed.

title: A user or chat named by Grams history is marked asked even when the request never left
trigger: Open My Grams while the connection is down or chats_path_active is false for a moment; a page lands naming a sender; grams_tick sets peers_dirty=false and tries getUser/getChat.
effect: asked_users/asked_chats get the id on both Ok and Err, and peers_dirty is already cleared, so the row keeps its placeholder for the whole session (missing_* is only filled on an error answer).
fix: Per-peer enum {Unknown, Asked(RequestId), Missing, Known}; set Asked only after a successful send and fall back to Unknown on the Err arm.

title: GramsHub holds loaded + loading + error + request, probed, peers_dirty and one-shot withdraw_url/withdraw_too_small as separate fields
trigger: Open My Grams, switch tabs, collect, close.
effect: Page stage is four fields; 'probed' is an Option-like started flag that is never cleared after a failed probe (the row stays hidden for the session); withdraw_url and withdraw_too_small are one-shot notices drained by main-window frame upkeep only.
fix: Fetch<GramsPage> keyed by request id; probe as Fetch<i64>; the withdraw outcome as a variant of GramWithdraw (Done(url), TooSmall) instead of side flags.

title: Collect password box goes idle with no message when the request fails to send
trigger: Open Collect, type the password, submit while the send fails (not connected).
effect: withdraw is replaced by Password{request: None, error: None}; the Err is returned but the box shows no error, so Submit looks like it did nothing.
fix: Put the send error into GramWithdraw::idle(Some(error)) on the Err arm.

title: GiftValueLookup stage is loading + open + error + info + request
trigger: Click 'learn more' on a unique gift, fail, retry, close, reopen, switch gift.
effect: land/fail guard on loading && id==request, but 'open' is set only on land and cleared by close; the lookup survives closing so its stage is spread over five fields.
fix: enum GiftValueLookupStage { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed(String), Ready{info, open: bool} } or Fetch<GiftValueInfo> plus a separate box-open flag in the dialog state.

title: A failed privacy set leaves the optimistic call privacy mirrored in calls state
trigger: Settings > Calls (or Privacy > Calls), change Who can call me; setUserPrivacySettingRules fails (e.g. PRIVACY_TOO_LONG).
effect: set_privacy_rules calls mirror_call_privacy(key, &detail) before the answer; the error arm only sets PrivacyKeyState::Failed, so calls.privacy_allow_calls / privacy_p2p keep the rejected value and the older call code reads it.
fix: Derive the call fields from settings.privacy on read instead of mirroring them, or restore them from the previous detail in the SetPrivacyRules error arm.

title: A failed privacy set marks the key Failed whichever of several sets failed, and drops the real value
trigger: Change a privacy rule twice in quick succession (the second applies optimistically, both are in flight); the first one fails, or one fails on its own.
effect: The key becomes PrivacyKeyState::Failed ('Couldn't load') although the server kept the old or the second value; the row is not editable until the screen is reopened and refetched. A late getPrivacyRules answer for the same key also overwrites a newer optimistic Ready because answers are not matched to the newest request for the key.
fix: Per-key state {Loading(RequestId), Ready{detail, saving: Option<RequestId>}, Failed}; a set failure restores the previous detail and shows an error, and answers apply only for the key's live request id.

title: Read-date privacy is read_date_show: Option<bool> + read_date_loading + read_date_error
trigger: Privacy screen: toggle 'show read time', fail, reopen.
effect: One loading flag serves both getReadDatePrivacy and setReadDatePrivacy; a get answer landing during a set clears loading and overwrites the optimistic value; the failure arm clears the value to None by hand.
fix: Fetch<bool> with a Saving(Option<RequestId>) sub-state, as for the other privacy rules.

title: The Premium bot auto-start survives until some later visit to that bot
trigger: Press Subscribe (Bot route) so auto_start is set, then lose the resolve (switch account before the answer, or the resolve never reaches the chat), and later open the Premium bot by link or search.
effect: hub.auto_start is in the Session, cleared only by the send error and the chat-resolve error arms; take_premium_auto_start matches only the username, so Quill sends '/start <ref>' to the bot with no user action. The background account keeps it too.
fix: Tie it to the resolve request (an Option<RequestId> with the username) and drop it when that request answers or the screen epoch changes.

title: A getPremiumLimit that was lost or timed out is never asked again this session
trigger: Open a limit box right after connecting on a flaky link; the request is swept (408) or fails transiently.
effect: LimitStore::note_asked is set before the send and only forget_asked on a send Err; no error handler for GetPremiumLimit clears it, so the box uses the hardcoded fallback pair for the rest of the session.
fix: Per-kind state {Unasked, Asked(RequestId), Answered(pair), Refused}; clear Asked on a transient error and keep Refused only for the server's refusal.

title: CameraDraft stage is starting + stream + live + shot + drawn + rgb
trigger: Open the photo camera, take a photo, retake, camera unplugged.
effect: starting bool next to stream Option and shot Option; Starting/Live/Taken/Stopped are inferred from combinations (can_take = live && stream && !busy). A serial counter on PhotoSources is the only match for the worker answers.
fix: enum CameraStage { Starting(serial), Live{stream, frame}, Taken{path, image}, Stopped(note) }.

title: StarAmount::label calls stars.abs() on an i64 read from JSON
trigger: A malformed or hostile star_count of i64::MIN in a starAmount.
effect: Overflow panic in debug builds (wrap in release) while drawing the balance or a history row.
fix: Use unsigned_abs() as group_digits does.

title: enable() rolls back wrapped files after some OS-store keys were already deleted, losing database keys
trigger: Two or more accounts signed in. Settings > Passcode > Turn on. Every account's key is wrapped and written, the config is saved, then the loop `for account in &written { inner.delete(account)? }` runs. The first account's key is deleted from the OS secret store, the delete for the second fails (keychain locked/denied, secret service error).
effect: `rollback(&written)` removes every wrapped file and passcode.json, but the first account's key is already gone from the OS store and its wrapped copy is now deleted too. Its TDLib database can never be opened again: the account is lost (forced re-login, local data unreadable). Contradicts the doc comment 'no database key is ever lost'.
fix: Make the migration a staged value (Wrapped -> Committed -> StoreCleared) and on a delete failure do not roll back files for accounts whose OS copy is already deleted: either re-put the deleted keys into `inner` before removing wrapped files, or keep passcode enabled and retry the remaining deletes.

title: PaidMessages::forget_answers is never called, so the Premium gate stays stale after the viewer buys Premium
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who restricts new chats (composer shows 'only accepts messages from contacts and Premium users'). Buy/receive Premium (updateOption is_premium / user update). The doc says 'After the viewer's Premium changes, old answers are wrong'.
effect: `forget_answers` has no caller outside its test (grep). The cached CanSend::RestrictsNewChats answer is only refreshed by `should_ask` after GATE_REFRESH_MS (5 minutes) and only on a chat open, so the composer stays blocked by the Premium prompt although the viewer now has Premium (send_gate reads viewer_premium only when it rebuilds, but PremiumRequired is computed live from my_is_premium; the opposite case, a Premium that lapses, keeps Free for up to 5 minutes and the send is rejected by the server). Price answers for other users are not re-asked either.
fix: Call forget_answers (and sync_paid_guard) from the Session's is_premium change, or key the cached answer by the viewer's Premium flag so a change makes it stale by construction.

title: One PaidSave slot is shared by every Remove Fee and Direct Messages save; answers do not check the target
trigger: Start 'Remove fee' for user A (PaidSave::Saving(User A)), open Remove Fee for user B (open_remove_fee_for sets Idle) or save a channel's Direct Messages meanwhile; then A's answer arrives.
effect: `finish_unpaid_exception` and the SetDirectMessagesGroup success arm set `save = Idle` whatever the target, wiping another save's Saving/Failed state; a failure for A overwrites B's state and `user_error()` returns the failure line of any user, so B's box can show A's error line. The Saving state of B (button disabled) is dropped while its request is still in flight.
fix: Keep saves as a map keyed by PaidTarget (or only reset when the answer's target equals the stored one).

title: Paid trust persistence is two bools kept in step by hand (trust_loaded, trust_dirty)
trigger: load_paid_trust sets trust_loaded before reading the file; sync_paid_guard clears trust_dirty before save_paid_trust writes (write errors ignored).
effect: A failed trust write leaves trust_dirty false, so the forgotten price is never retried and returns after restart (the user is not asked again for a price the user stopped paying). trust_loaded true with a failed read means an unreadable file is treated as empty and later overwritten.
fix: enum TrustStore { Unloaded, Loaded(PaidTrust), Dirty(PaidTrust) } with the save result deciding whether it returns to Loaded.

title: A failed canSendMessageToUser leaves the chat ungated and blocks a retry for 30 s
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who charges Stars while the request fails (flood wait, network error). apply_privacy_data_error for CanSendMessageToUser does nothing and never calls ask_failed (only a failed send does).
effect: `asking` keeps the user for ASK_TIMEOUT_MS (wall clock) so re-opening the chat does not ask again; the composer shows no price and PaidGuard has no price for the chat, so the send goes to TDLib unannounced and fails with a server error instead of the Stars confirmation. The stage (none / asking / answered / failed) is split over `gates`, `asking` and two timestamps.
fix: enum GateFetch { Unknown, Asking{at}, Known{answer,at}, Failed{at} } per user; the error arm moves Asking to Failed and the send path refuses while the gate is not Known.

title: Local pending Star reactions are dropped before TDLib confirms commit/undo, so TDLib's pending total can exceed what the user saw
trigger: Tap the Star reaction (addPending sent, local entry kept). When the 5.5 s timer ends, take_due removes the entry and the commit request fails (send error or error answer), or tap Undo and removePendingPaidMessageReactions fails. Tap the same message again.
effect: Only a note is set ('Stars were not sent' / 'Couldn't undo the Stars'). TDLib still holds the earlier pending Stars for that message, local state says none, so the next tap shows a toast and balance check for the new amount only while the commit that follows spends old + new Stars. The user pays more Stars than the toast showed. The refusal/balance check (total_pending) also ignores the lost reservation.
fix: Make each pending item an enum PendingPaid { Waiting, Committing(request), Undoing(request) } that leaves the list only on TDLib's ok; on error return it to Waiting (or issue removePending) so local and TDLib totals agree.

title: rollback after a refused addPending is matched by chat+message, not by the tap that failed
trigger: Tap Star reaction on a message (request E1 fails slowly, e.g. flood), tap again after the timer fired so a new entry for the same message exists, then E1's error arrives.
effect: rollback subtracts E1's stars from the newer entry (or removes it), so the toast and the reserved total differ from what TDLib holds, and a later commit sends a different amount than shown.
fix: Give each tap an id (the request id) stored in the pending item and roll back only that tap.

title: Paid reaction picker state is single-slot Options not tied to an owner (offered, senders, note)
trigger: Open the message reaction menu on message A in the main window and on message B in a chat window; open the Star box in two chats in turn.
effect: `offered` holds one (chat,message) for the whole account, `senders` holds the channels of one chat only (fetching for chat B drops A's, and the request is not tracked in flight, so re-opening re-asks), and `note` is a free-text last refusal that is only cleared by the next successful add.
fix: Move offered into the per-chat reaction menu state (ChatUi), make senders a map of Fetch<Vec<i64>> per chat, and make note part of the toast value.

title: Premium gift message is cut to nothing when gift_text_length_max is not known yet
trigger: Sign in, open a user's profile > Gift Premium before the gift_text_length_max option arrives (or it failed: error arm sets it to None), type a message and pay. invoice_checkout.rs:138 passes `gift_text_length_max.unwrap_or(0)`.
effect: `text.trim().chars().take(0)` yields an empty string, so a paid Premium gift (Stars or card) is sent without the message the sender wrote, with no warning.
fix: Treat an unknown limit as 'ask first' (disable Pay until Fetch<usize> is Ready) or as no cut, never as 0.

title: adding sticks when the addLoginPasskey answer cannot be parsed or its continuation is dropped
trigger: Create Passkey; complete the ceremony; the server's `passkey` answer has no id (Passkey::parse returns None, parse_payload returns None) or the request is dropped by a reconnect/closed client.
effect: `adding` is cleared only by accept_added and the Add error arm. Otherwise passkey_creation_busy() stays true and begin_register/finish_register refuse (`state.adding`), so Create Passkey stays disabled for the rest of the session.
fix: One enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Sending(request), Done } with the request id; clear Sending on any answer to that id and when the request is dropped.

title: An in-flight list answer undoes a removal and clears the stale mark
trigger: Open Passkeys (getLoginPasskeys in flight), delete a passkey before the list answer lands. removeLoginPasskey ok sets stale=true but request_passkeys skips because the List is in flight; then the older list answer arrives.
effect: accept_list replaces the list (the deleted passkey is back), sets known=true and stale=false, so no refetch happens and the deleted passkey shows until the user leaves and returns after more than 5 s.
fix: Carry a list generation (bumped by finish_remove) in the List request and apply the answer only when it matches; otherwise keep stale=true.

title: PasskeysState spreads the list fetch, removal and registration over eight fields
trigger: known/stale/requested_at drive the fetch; removing/error drive removal; registration/ceremony/adding/added drive the add flow; error is shared by all three.
effect: A failed removal and a failed list share one `error` string; `added` is a one-shot flag the UI takes; `ceremony` and `registration` hold the same options twice.
fix: List: Fetch<Vec<Passkey>> with a stale generation; removal: Option<Removal{id, request}> in the list value; registration: one enum (see 04-p2-010) with its own error.

title: Passkey sign-in stage is config_requested, pending, ceremony, checking and error
trigger: QR sign-in screen: link click, options fetch, ceremony, checkAuthenticationPasskey.
effect: `checking: bool` is set before the request and cleared only by ok/fail/send error; a dropped request or an auth state that moves on by itself leaves it true until the next fail(). `config_requested` is a once-only flag kept on a Session that survives logout.
fix: enum LoginStage { Idle, FetchingOptions(request), Ceremony(options), Checking(request), Failed(String) } reset whole when the authorization state leaves the QR screen.

title: Passkey creation options that arrive after the user cancelled still start a system sheet
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Passkeys > Create Passkey, then Cancel/Esc (close_passkey_ceremony) before getPasskeyParameters answers.
effect: close_passkey_ceremony only clears the UI ceremony; the request is not cancelled and the driver's `passkeys.ceremony` is not cleared. apply_passkey_parameters then stores `ceremony`, the still-running ticker (passkey_creation_busy is true while the request is in flight) takes it in tick_passkey_ceremony and starts a hardware-key/system ceremony with a box the user already closed.
fix: Tie the options to a request id held in the registration enum; closing the box moves the stage to Idle so a late answer is ignored.

title: A finished passkey ceremony is dropped silently when finish_register / finish_login refuses
trigger: Create Passkey, touch the key; between the ceremony start and its end `chats_path_active()` turned false (reconnect) or `adding` is still true from the previous try. For sign-in, the authorization state moved on.
effect: `let _ = live.driver.finish_register(&registration)` ignores the Err: the dialog closes as if saved but no passkey is added and no message is shown; the user touched the key for nothing.
fix: Surface the Err as a note and keep the dialog on an error sheet, or queue the registration until the connection is back.

title: Do Not Disturb probe is three process-wide atomics (DND, CHECKED_AT_MS, REFRESHING)
trigger: Any alert decision calls dnd_active(); a stale answer starts a worker.
effect: No bug today: REFRESHING is cleared by a drop guard even on panic. The answer is false until the first refresh lands, so the very first notification after start in Do Not Disturb may still play (warm() mitigates).
fix: One Mutex<enum Dnd { Unknown, Known{on,at}, Refreshing{last} }>.

title: ProxyState keeps the list fetch and the mutation as loading/stale/mutating/fetch_attempted bools beside error and list
trigger: Open Settings > Connection, add or remove a proxy; code in connect/proxy.rs sets loading/mutating before the send and the reducer clears them by purpose
effect: none today (settle_lost_request clears them via error.rs); loading+error and stale+loading can be set together
fix: Fetch<Vec<ProxyEntry>> for the list plus a Mutation enum (Idle, InFlight(RequestId), Failed(String)); stale becomes a Refetch variant of the fetch.

title: getProxies answer matched by purpose, not by request id; explicit refresh does not dedupe an in-flight fetch
trigger: Open the proxy list (fetch_proxies sends getProxies without checking has_purpose) while a fetch or a mutation's refetch is already out, then add a proxy
effect: The first answer clears loading and stale although a second request is still out, or an answer sent before the mutation lands after stale=true and clears it, so the list shows the pre-change proxies until the next change
fix: Fetch<T> carrying the RequestId of the getProxies it waits for; apply an answer only when its id is the current one, and let a mutation answer re-arm the refetch after it.

title: Proxy auto-switch is a hand-kept machine: disconnected_since_ms, pings map (Checking) and RotationAction results fed back by the caller
trigger: Enable auto-switch with 2+ proxies and lose the connection; the caller must insert Checking/Available into pings between steps
effect: none today; a Checking ping blocks rotation for every slot including LINK_PING_ID until that answer or error arrives
fix: enum Rotation { Watching, Disconnected{since}, Probing{id}, Switching{id} } owned by the rotation step instead of Checking entries in the shared ping map.

title: PsaLabels marks a type requested before the request and never clears it on a failed send or error answer
trigger: Open the app while offline or with a failed languagePackStrings request while a promoted announcement is on the list (pump_psa_labels ignores the send result)
effect: The row badge and the one-time about box keep the generic text for that type until the language changes or Quill restarts
fix: Per-type Fetch<String> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) so an error or failed send returns the type to Idle and the next pump retries.

title: PsaAbout load is an enum but waiting: Option<ChatId>, toast: Option and dirty bool must stay in step with it
trigger: Open a chat before the background read of psa_about_seen.json finished
effect: none today; waiting is only meaningful while load != Done, dirty is cleared before the save thread runs so a save with no file path loses the flag
fix: Fold waiting into Load::Reading{slot, waiting} and make toast an enum Hidden/Showing/Waiting.

title: PullMachine encodes its stage as pulling/holding/committed/jumping/reached/expand_to/expand_pending/dwell_due/has_next/shown/ready/hint_on/hint_ready
trigger: Pull past the bottom of a channel on a trackpad, hold, release
effect: none by itself; but jumping has no exit except reset/reset_all called by the UI (see pull_next_ui.rs findings)
fix: enum Stage { Idle, Pulling{reached, committed, has_next}, Jumping } with the tweens as data of the stage; Jumping carries a deadline so it has its own way out.

title: begin_jump enters Jumping before the jump can start or finish; several paths leave the machine in Jumping with no exit
trigger: Pull and release on a ready channel/topic pull when (a) pull.window is None, (b) select_topic_ui(next) does not change the topic, or (c) select_chat_request returns true but the chat does not change; machine.jumping() stays true
effect: The next-channel indicator stays at full height with the photo and the history stays lifted; handle() returns early while jumping so no new pull can start in this chat or topic until the user changes chat/topic
fix: Make Jumping carry the awaited ChatId/topic and a deadline; the frame clears it when the target is shown, when it times out, or when the jump task ends without opening it (task completion calls reset).

title: pull_jump_when_ready continuation opens the next chat without asking the lock gate
trigger: Pull and release to jump to the next unread channel, then lock Quill within the 1.5 s wait
effect: select_chat_request runs under the passcode lock: the next channel's chat is selected (and read marking/draft flush runs) behind the lock screen, and shows after unlock; the jump task polls driver state while locked
fix: Check refused_while_locked at the start of the continuation (drop the jump and reset the machine) per lock-is-a-render-state.

title: quote_for resolves a selection by first occurrence of its text, not by where the user selected it
trigger: Select the second occurrence of a repeated phrase (e.g. the second 'ok.' or a repeated word) in a message and reply with a quote
effect: The quote's position points at the first occurrence, so the reply preview highlights and Telegram scrolls to the wrong part of the message
fix: Take the selection's byte start from the selection source and pass it to quote_for instead of searching for the string.

title: Shared carrier lifecycle is three atomics: ready, failed, closing, plus the child Option and queued count
trigger: Open, fail and close a web proxy carrier from different threads (writer, reader, UI)
effect: none today (fail() orders closing/failed with swap); the stage is implicit across threads
fix: AtomicU8-backed CarrierStage enum (Starting, Ready, Failed, Closing) advanced by compare_exchange so every transition is one place.

title: HelperCarrierHost claim state is generation: Option plus claim_after: Option kept in step by data_dir_arg
trigger: Account folder cannot be claimed (read-only data dir), then it becomes writable
effect: none today; carriers are refused for 10 s after each failed claim
fix: enum Folder { Claimed(Generation), RetryAfter(Instant), NotConfigured }.

title: Carrier table is kept in step with ProxyState::carrier_failed and Carriers::hosting by hand
trigger: A web proxy is enabled; its carrier is refused or fails; the user enables another proxy or the host capability flips
effect: none today; carrier_failed is cleared in apply_added_proxies and apply_web_proxy_carrier, hosting by apply_carrier_hosting
fix: Derive the row state from Carriers (carrier of the enabled proxy_id with phase Failed) and drop carrier_failed.

title: An existing but unreadable accounts.json loads as the default registry, and the next save overwrites the real file
trigger: accounts.json exists but fs::read fails once (AV lock on Windows, EIO, permission blip); then add account / switch account / toggle notify-from-all calls load_registry then save_registry
effect: load_registry hits `None => return AccountRegistry::default()` (stamp is Some), the caller saves [primary] plus its change over the real list: every other account and any pending_deletes vanish from the registry, their folders are orphaned and need a fresh sign-in
fix: Make load return Result<Loaded, Unreadable>/an enum {Missing, Corrupt, Unreadable, Ok}; read-modify-write callers refuse to save on Unreadable instead of starting from the default.

title: Account lifecycle is three fields kept in step by hand: accounts, pending_deletes and active
trigger: remove an account / lock-screen log out: begin_remove_account moves the key from accounts to pending_deletes, mark_for_deletion leaves it in both, finish_pending_delete clears it
effect: an account can be listed and pending-delete at once (mark_for_deletion) or only pending (begin_remove); active must be re-pointed by hand in two places (begin_remove_account, tidy_registry)
fix: enum AccountEntry { Listed, Removing{folder pending}, WipeOnNextStart } in one Vec<(AccountKey, AccountEntry)>, active as an index/key into the Listed ones only.

title: Quarantining a corrupt accounts.json forgets pending_deletes, so a requested wipe is not finished
trigger: lock-screen Log out records every account in pending_deletes, Quill quits or crashes, accounts.json is found unparsable on the next start
effect: the file is renamed aside and the default registry (primary, no pending deletes) is used; the folders the user asked to wipe stay on disk and primary opens its old database
fix: On a corrupt registry, recover pending_deletes from the quarantined text (or a separate wipe marker file) before starting any client.

title: Registry read-modify-write is not serialized: two writers lose one update
trigger: add_account on one thread while another thread runs set_active_account/begin_remove_account/set_notify_from_all (each does load_registry, edit, save_registry with no lock held across the three steps)
effect: the second save overwrites the first: a new account or a pending delete silently disappears
fix: One `update_registry(app_root, |&mut AccountRegistry|)` that holds a mutex across load and save; the other functions call it.

title: A failed create_dir_all drops the user's recent hashtags instead of keeping them
trigger: an earlier build left recent_hashtags.json in the app folder, the primary account is registered but its folder cannot be created (read-only, full disk); start Quill
effect: `registered && create_dir_all.is_ok() && let Err = move_item` is false when create_dir_all fails, so control falls to remove_any(&stray) and deletes the only copy of the list
fix: Return early (keep the stray) when the owner folder cannot be created; only remove the stray when the account is gone or already has its own list.

title: Theme selection is spread over theme, auto_night, day_theme, night_theme and follow_omarchy, written together by hand
trigger: pick a theme in the chooser (src/ui/app_theme/mod.rs:368-374 sets follow_omarchy=false, night_theme or day_theme, and theme=Dark/Light); Omarchy follow turns follow_omarchy on elsewhere
effect: theme (legacy light/dark/high-contrast) duplicates which slot is active and can disagree with day_theme/night_theme (a missing custom theme resets only the slot, chooser.rs:460); no bug seen today
fix: enum ThemeSource { Omarchy, Manual{day, night, night_mode: AutoNight}, HighContrast } as the single stored value.

title: highlight_emoji_words is only meaningful while suggest_emoji is on; the pair is kept in step by readers
trigger: turn Suggest emoji off in Settings > Chats with highlight on
effect: the stored highlight flag stays true and comes back when suggest_emoji is turned on again; every reader must test both
fix: enum EmojiSuggest { Off, On{highlight_words: bool} }.

title: Send To switch stats the Send To folder on the UI thread every render, and concurrent toggles can finish out of order
trigger: Windows: open Settings > General (rendered each frame calls is_enabled -> SHGetKnownFolderPath + is_file); click the switch twice quickly (two background_spawn set_enabled tasks)
effect: per-frame blocking shell/disk IO on the UI thread while the page is open; the two background tasks can finish in either order so the shortcut ends in the state of the first click, not the last
fix: Read once into a Fetch<bool>/enum {Known(bool), Applying{want}, Failed} on the settings screen; refuse or queue a click while Applying.

title: The send-button morph lives in composer_ui, not ChatUi, so switching chats fades from the previous chat's button state
trigger: chat A shows Send (text typed), click chat B whose composer is empty (Record)
effect: a 120 ms cross-fade from A's glyph to B's runs on first draw (and requests animation ticks) although B's button never changed
fix: Key the SendMorph by chat (put it in ChatUi, replaced on chat change) so a new chat starts settled.
